title: India markets brace after US tech wobble, rupee holds steady
excerpt: Indian equities retreated sharply on Monday as global tech stocks fell and financials slumped, while the rupee remained flat at 92.90 per dollar. Volatility rose and investors are likely to stay defensive ahead of key domestic and overseas data releases.

title: Indian markets tumble as banks slide, US AI rally fuels mixed sentiment
excerpt: The Nifty 50 and Sensex closed down more than 1.7% on Monday, led by a 3.2% fall in Bank Nifty, while US equity indices surged on renewed AI enthusiasm. A weaker rupee, higher US yields and falling oil prices add pressure, leaving investors cautious ahead of the Indian open.
